**Recommend.** Send 3,000 L petrol Gazipur → Mirpur (route-gazipur-mirpur).

**Why.** Mirpur petrol is projected to run out in 3.2 h (P = 0.78). Tongi petrol is projected to run out in 5.5 h (P = 0.41, no backup route). Demand 31% above forecast for 6 ticks. route-gazipur-tongi DISRUPTED until tick 216. Gazipur petrol supply delayed to tick 234.

**Binding constraints.** depot-gazipur dispatch 12,000 L/tick; station-mirpur petrol headroom 12,000 L incl. in transit.

**Projected impact.** 1,296 L projected unmet demand avoided vs the no-action counterfactual (1,496 L → 200 L over the Twin horizon). These are projections from our Decision Twin, not outcomes.

**Alternatives considered.** Do nothing: 1,496 L projected unmet; Send 5,000 L: 550 L projected unmet (Tongi short later).

**Confidence.** Confidence 0.74; this decision needs operator approval: confidence 0.74 < 0.80; active event: demand_spike, route_disruption.
